newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures down on soft physical market.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures down on soft physical market.

text.p: LIFFE wheat and barley futures fell on soft physical markets and sterling's strength, traders said.
"The buyers just don't need to buy," one trader said.
Active May wheat last traded down one stg at 93.65 stg on volume of 161 lots. Total wheat volume was 296 lots.
Barley was more active than in recent days, with a total of 53 lots traded. More than half the volume, 30 lots, was on March, which last traded unchanged at 91 stg.
Sterling had not risen sharply during the day, but just by maintaining a steady level against other European currencies it was enough to act as a bearish factor, traders said.
Tuesday's sterling green rate revaluation had had no direct effect, traders said. "Everybody knew (in advance) about the green rate change," one said.
